text: dsh-browser-mode（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH 增加「浏览器操作」会话模式，让 Agent 通过 Playwright 浏览器工具完成网页导航和交互。插件挂载浏览器 provider，并提供 browser_access 授权工具；普通会话经用户同意后才能使用浏览器。用户可选择 Microsoft Edge、Playwright 内置 Chromium，或连接已运行的 CDP 浏览器，也可在插件页面调整来源、地址、可执行文件和无头选项。适合需要在 DSH 会话中操作网页的用户；不需要 API 密钥，连接已有浏览器时需提供 CDP 地址。

dsh-browser-mode adds browser sessions to DSH. Agents use Playwright to operate pages; other sessions request consent with browser_access. Choose Edge, bundled Chromium, or CDP, and edit options in Plugins settings. No API key is needed.
我想让 DSH 会话能直接打开网页并进行点击和填写。
怎么让普通会话在我同意后才使用浏览器工具？
Can I connect a DSH session to Edge or a running browser over CDP?
dsh-browser-mode 的功能「会话浏览器授权」：非浏览器模式会话调用浏览器前可通过 browser_access 请求用户同意；同意后仅该会话可继续使用浏览器工具。
dsh-browser-mode 的功能「切换浏览器来源」：通过 browser_source 选择 Edge、内置 Chromium 或 CDP 地址；设置保存后重新挂载 provider，插件页也能编辑来源与启动选项。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · dsh-browser-mode：中文 | [English](README.en.md)

[](https://github.com/Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode/releases)
[](LICENSE)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件包：新增一个「浏览器操作」会话模式，浏览器来源可在运行时切换（默认 Edge），其它会话在用户明确同意前无法打开浏览器。

依赖对齐 DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`（Windows 11 + Edge）。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 特性：- 可见浏览器：默认 `headless: false`，能看着它操作，也能随时接管。
- 浏览器来源可选：Edge（默认）、Playwright 内置 Chromium、或连接一个已经开着的浏览器（CDP）。
- 两种入口：新建「浏览器操作」会话，或就在当前会话里让模型申请授权。
- 按会话授权：授权只对当时那个 Agent 生效，存在插件内存里，重启或重开会话需重新同意。
- 拒绝可解释：被拦下时模型拿到的是中文说明和后续做法，而不是一句 `permission denied`。
- 失败即关闭：读不到预设、问答服务不可用、provider 未加载时，一律按「不可用浏览器」处理。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 一键安装：DSH 插件管理器的安装框接受 git 地址。把下面这一行粘贴到「包名或地址」：

```
github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode
```

等价的工具调用：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target:github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode
```

安装会写入 profile 依赖 `"@local/dsh-browser-mode": "github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode"`，并自动启用包内三行：预设 `preset-browser`、来源 `browser-source`、门禁 `browser-gate`。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 首次使用前的一次性配置：在 `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/cordis.patch.yml` 里保留共享的 `browserUse` 注册表行（若已存在则跳过）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: browser-use
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use"
```

Playwright MCP provider 由本插件的 `browser-source` 行负责挂载，**不需要**单独的 provider 行。这样浏览器来源才能在运行时切换。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 从 1.5.1 或更早版本升级：请删掉 `browser-use-playwright-mcp` 那一行（`browser-use` 保留）。一个进程里只能有一个 provider；旧行还在时 `browser-source` 只打印一条迁移提示，不会接管。
section: 首次使用前的一次性配置

text:
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 更新到新版本：插件市场对 `github:owner/repo` 这种浮动源会读取仓库默认分支的 `package.json` 版本号做比较，所以每次发版只要改版本号并 push：

```powershell
git tag v1.6.0
git push && git push --tags
```

已安装的用户在插件市场点「更新」，或手工执行下面两条（`pnpm` 会把 GitHub 依赖重新解析到默认分支最新提交）：

```powershell
pnpm add "github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode"
```

```
plugin_manager set_bundle enabled:false target:@local/dsh-browser-mode
plugin_manager set_bundle enabled:true  target:@local/dsh-browser-mode
```

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 确认安装结果：```
plugin_manager list_plugins
```

`include:preset-browser`、`include:browser-source`、`include:browser-gate` 三行都应是 `enabled: true`、`fiberPhase: "active"`。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 使用：**方式一：浏览器模式会话**（整段网页任务）

新建会话时把模式选为「浏览器操作」。该会话内模型直接调用 `browser_navigate` 等工具，不再询问。

**方式二：当前会话里申请**

直接说「用浏览器打开这个页面并填好」。模型第一次调用浏览器工具时会被拦下，随后调用 `browser_access`，界面弹出：

```
允许使用浏览器
是否允许我在这个会话里打开浏览器？用途：……
[允许]  [不允许]
```

点「允许」后，该会话后续的浏览器调用全部放行；点「不允许」，模型改用 `web_search`、`web_fetch`、文件与命令行继续。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 浏览器来源：默认用 Microsoft Edge。三种来源：

| `source` | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `edge` | 启动本机 Edge（找不到时退回 Playwright 内置 Chromium） |
| `builtin` | 启动 Playwright 自带的 Chromium（`~/AppData/Local/ms-playwright/chromium-*`） |
| `endpoint` | 连接一个已经启动、开了调试端口的浏览器（`--cdp-endpoint`），此时独占，多会话不能共用 |
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 在插件页面设置：「插件」页里本插件卡片上的设置页可以直接选来源、填 CDP 地址、改 Edge 路径、切换无头，保存后立即生效（和工具一样，已打开会话的浏览器工具会失效）。这个页面与 `browser_source` 工具读写同一份配置，两种方式可以混用。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 让模型切换：在任意会话里说「换成内置浏览器」「连接我开着的浏览器」，模型会调用 `browser_source`：

```
browser_source({ source: "builtin" })
browser_source({ source: "endpoint", endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:9222" })
```

不带参数时只回显当前配置。切换会立刻重挂 provider：已经打开的浏览器会话里的工具会失效，请新开一个「浏览器操作」会话再打开页面。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 手工改配置：切换结果保存在 `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/browser-source.json`（Windows 上是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\browser-source.json`）。用文件而不是 Loader 配置，是因为重装或管理插件时 Loader 的配置文档会被重写，而这个文件不会。删除它即回到默认（Edge）。

也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖本行：文件里记录着写入时的行配置快照，**你事后手改过的字段优先**，没改过的字段继续用文件里的选择（用 `browser_source` 切换会刷新快照）。

```yaml
- id: browser-source
  name: "@local/dsh-browser-mode/browser-source"
  config:
    source: builtin        # edge | builtin | endpoint

接远程浏览器时，先让浏览器以调试端口启动，例如：

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 为什么 provider 由本插件挂载：把 provider 塞进预设的三条路都试过，全部失败：

| 做法 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| provider 行放进预设 | 加载报错 `Preset services require isolate realms: browserUse` |
| 放进 `isolate: { browserUse: true }` 组 | 预设能加载，但 provider 收不到 `agent/created`，会话里没有 `browser_*` 工具 |
| 预设里再挂一个 provider | 与 profile 的那个重名，调用时报 `playwright-mcp: browser tool belongs to another Session` |

所以 provider 只能挂在 profile 层。本插件用 `browser-source` 这一行代挂，好处是：provider 的启动参数由插件自己算，改来源时销毁旧 fiber 再挂新的，不用重启 DSH。代价是 provider 会给**每个**会话注册浏览器工具，所以需要门禁。
section: 为什么 provider 由本插件挂载

text:
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 为什么门禁只能拒绝、不能隐藏：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `tools.restrict()` 只过滤一个作用域**继承来**的工具（全局层与祖先层）：

> Restrictions filter what a scope inherits … never what its OWN layer registers.

而 provider 用 `createScope(ctx, agent)` 把工具注册进该 Agent **自己的**层，任何 `restrict()` 都过滤不到（实测：普通会话仍能看到 24 个 `mcp__playwright-mcp__*` 工具名）。

唯一有效的杠杆是 `tools.guard()`：它在调用管线里同步执行，返回字符串即拒绝，且没有监听器能把拒绝改回放行。

决策顺序：

```
浏览器工具调用
  ├─ 名字不以 mcp__playwright-mcp__ 开头 → 不处理
  ├─ 是 browser_access                → 不处理
  ├─ Agent 的预设是 browser            → 放行
section: 为什么门禁只能拒绝、不能隐藏

text: @local/dsh-browser-mode README · 授权如何记录：`browser_access` 调用 `ctx.userQuestions.ask({ questions, agent, signal })`；用户选「允许」后，把该 Agent 的 id 记进插件内存的 `Set`。不落盘，不跨会话，不跨重启。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 来源（`browser-source`，bundle 内）：| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `edge` | `edge` / `builtin` / `endpoint` |
| `endpoint` | 空 | `source: endpoint` 时连接的目标地址 |
| `executablePath` | 空 | 自定义浏览器路径；空则用 Edge 默认安装位置 |
| `headless` | `false` | 改为 `true` 则隐藏窗口，调试时建议保持可见 |

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 门禁：`browser-gate.js` 顶部常量：

```js
const TOOL_PREFIX = 'mcp__playwright-mcp__'  // provider 的工具前缀
const BROWSER_PRESET = 'browser'             // 直接用浏览器的预设 id
const ACCESS_TOOL = 'browser_access'         // 申请授权用的工具名
const DENIED = '……'                          // 拒绝时给模型看的文字

改 `preset-browser` 的 `id` 时，`BROWSER_PRESET` 必须一起改，否则门禁永远不认这个模式。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 验证清单：1. 普通会话里让它打开某个网址：应收到拒绝语，且不弹浏览器窗口。
2. 同一会话里说「我同意你用浏览器」：出现「允许 / 不允许」，点「允许」后再次打开网址，应弹出可见窗口。
3. 新建「浏览器操作」会话：直接打开网址，不询问。
4. 让它做一步真实操作（点按钮、读标题），确认工具确实在页面上执行。
5. 说「换成内置浏览器」或调用 `browser_source({ source: "builtin" })`：下一次打开页面应换成 Playwright 自带 Chromium。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 预设列表里没有「浏览器操作」 | bundle 未启用或预设行失败 | 看 `list_plugins` 里 `include:preset-browser` 是否 active |
| 加载报 `Preset services require isolate realms: browserUse` | provider 行被放进了预设 | 把 provider 留在 profile 层，由 `browser-source` 挂载 |
| 会话里完全没有 `browser_*` 工具 | `browser-source` 未 active，或旧 `browser-use-playwright-mcp` 行还在 | 看 `include:browser-source`；删掉旧 provider 行后重载 |
| 报 `browser tool belongs to another Session` | 一个进程里有两个 Playwright provider | 只保留 `browser-source` 这一个 |
| 切换来源后浏览器没变 | 旧会话持有旧的 MCP 连接 | 在会话里重新调用一次浏览器工具 |
| 普通会话能直接开浏览器 | 门禁未生效 | 看 `include:browser-gate` 是否 active；改过代码需重载 |
| 点「允许」没反应，或报 `human interaction is unavailable` | 在子 Agent 里调用 | 授权只能在主会话完成 |
| 报 `content.some is not a function` | 旧版 `browser_access` 的 `output.render` 返回值不合规 | 升级到 ≥ 1.5.1 |
| `browser_source` 一直 `pending (waiting for service: browserUse)`，或安装时报这句话 | profile 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` 与当前 DSH 版本不一致，启动时被兼容性检查置为 `disabled` | 把 profile 里该依赖升到与 DSH 相同的版本，重启后重试 |

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 兼容性：- 验证环境：DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`、Windows 11、Edge。
- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp` 与 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，版本在 `package.json` 中声明；DSH 升级后同步调整。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` 的版本必须和 DSH 运行时一致：profile 兼容性检查会把 peer 与运行时不符的行直接置为 `disabled`，该行一被禁用，`browserUse` 服务就没人提供，`browser-source` 会一直 `pending`。
- 门禁只使用公开接口：`tools.guard()`、`tools.register()`、`agentPresets.composedPreset()`、`sessionProjections.stateOf()`、`userQuestions.ask()`。其中任何一个改名，`browser-gate` 会掉出 `active`，此时浏览器恢复为所有会话可用（门禁失效但不会破坏会话），升级后请重跑验证清单。
- 来源切换使用 `settings.update()` 写 volatile 字段 + `loader/volatile-update` 事件；DSH 去掉 volatile 通道时，切换会退化为报错并提示手工改 YAML（浏览器本身不受影响）。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 已知限制：- 普通会话里仍能**看到** `mcp__playwright-mcp__*` 工具名，只是调用会被拒绝。
- 浏览器状态（页面、登录态）只在单个会话内保留。
- 授权只存内存，重启即失效。
- 会话开始后不能切换预设，因此临时用浏览器走 `browser_access`，而不是切模式。
- 子 Agent 不能弹出问答，授权只能在主会话完成。
- 切换来源会重挂 provider，已打开的页面不会保留。

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · 文件：| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `browser-gate.js` | 门禁插件：`tools.guard` 拒绝 + `browser_access` 征求同意 |
| `browser-source.js` | 来源插件：挂载 Playwright MCP provider，支持 Edge / 内置 Chromium / CDP，并提供 `browser_source` 工具 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 预设 `preset-browser`、来源行 `browser-source`、门禁行 `browser-gate` |
| `package.json` | bundle 声明（`dsh.bundle.patch`）、导出、依赖 |
| `README.md`、`README.en.md` | 中文、英文说明 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本记录 |

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · dsh-browser-mode：[中文](README.md) | English

[](https://github.com/Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode/releases)
[](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that adds a **Browser mode** Session preset, lets you switch the browser source at runtime (Edge by default), and keeps every other Session from opening a browser until the user explicitly agrees.

Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (Windows 11 + Edge).

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Features：- Visible browser: `headless: false` by default, so you can watch it work and take over at any time.
- Selectable browser source: Edge (default), Playwright's bundled Chromium, or an already running browser over CDP.
- Two ways in: a dedicated Browser mode Session, or a consent prompt in the current Session.
- Per-Session consent: an approval applies only to that Agent and lives in plugin memory; restarting DSH or starting a new Session asks again.
- Explainable refusal: a blocked call returns a reason and the next step, not a bare `permission denied`.
- Fail closed: an unresolvable preset, a missing question service, or an unloaded provider all count as "no browser".

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · One paste：The plugin manager accepts git addresses. Paste this into its package field:

```
github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode
```

Equivalent tool call:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target:github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode
```

This records the dependency `"@local/dsh-browser-mode": "github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode"` in the profile and enables the bundle's three rows: the `preset-browser` preset, `browser-source`, and the `browser-gate`.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · One-time setup：Keep the shared `browserUse` registry row in `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/cordis.patch.yml` (skip if already present):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: browser-use
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use"
```

The Playwright MCP provider is mounted by this bundle's `browser-source` row, so it needs no provider row of its own. That is what makes runtime switching possible.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · One-time setup：> [!IMPORTANT]
> Upgrading from 1.5.1 or earlier: remove the `browser-use-playwright-mcp` row (keep `browser-use`). One process can host only one provider; while the old row exists `browser-source` logs a migration hint and stays passive.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Updating to a newer version：The plugin market compares the `version` in the default branch's `package.json` for floating `github:owner/repo` sources, so a release only needs a version bump and a push:

```powershell
git tag v1.6.0
git push && git push --tags
```

Installed users press "Update" in the plugin market, or run these (pnpm re-resolves the GitHub dependency to the default branch):

```powershell
pnpm add "github:Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode"
```

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Updating to a newer version：```
plugin_manager set_bundle enabled:false target:@local/dsh-browser-mode
plugin_manager set_bundle enabled:true  target:@local/dsh-browser-mode
```

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Confirm the install：```
plugin_manager list_plugins
```

`include:preset-browser`, `include:browser-source`, and `include:browser-gate` should all read `enabled: true` and `fiberPhase: "active"`.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Use：**Option 1: a Browser mode Session** (a whole web task)

Pick "浏览器操作" as the mode when creating a Session. The model calls `browser_navigate` and friends without asking.

**Option 2: ask from the current Session**

Say "open this page in the browser and fill it in". The first browser call is refused, the model calls `browser_access`, and the UI asks:

```
Allow browser use?
May I open a browser in this Session? Purpose: …
[Allow]  [Do not allow]
```
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Use：After Allow, every browser call in that Session passes; after Do not allow, the model falls back to `web_search`, `web_fetch`, files, and the shell.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Browser source：Edge is the default. Three sources:

| `source` | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `edge` | launches the local Microsoft Edge (falls back to Playwright's Chromium when it is not found) |
| `builtin` | launches Playwright's own Chromium (`~/AppData/Local/ms-playwright/chromium-*`) |
| `endpoint` | attaches to a browser already started with a debugging port (`--cdp-endpoint`); this mode is exclusive, one Session at a time |

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Set it on the plugin page：The settings page on this bundle's card in the Plugins view picks the source, fills the CDP endpoint, overrides the Edge path and toggles headless; saving takes effect immediately (and, like the tool, invalidates the browser tools of sessions that are already open). That page and the `browser_source` tool read and write the same configuration, so the two can be mixed.
section: Set it on the plugin page

text:
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Ask the model to switch：In any Session say "use the built-in browser" or "connect to my running browser"; the model calls `browser_source`:

```
browser_source({ source: "builtin" })
browser_source({ source: "endpoint", endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:9222" })
```

With no arguments it only reports the current configuration. A switch remounts the provider immediately: the tools in sessions that already opened pages stop working, so open a new "Browser operation" session before navigating.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Edit the configuration by hand：The choice is stored in `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/browser-source.json` (on Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\browser-source.json`). It is a plain file rather than Loader configuration because reinstalling or managing plugins rewrites the Loader's document while this file survives. Delete it to return to the default (Edge).

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Edit the configuration by hand：You can also override the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: the file records a snapshot of the row it was written against, so **keys you edited afterwards win**, while keys you did not touch keep the stored choice (a `browser_source` switch refreshes the snapshot).

```yaml
- id: browser-source
  name: "@local/dsh-browser-mode/browser-source"
  config:
    source: builtin        # edge | builtin | endpoint

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Why the bundle mounts the provider：All three attempts to keep the provider inside the preset failed:

| Approach | Result |
| --- | --- |
| provider row inside the preset | load error `Preset services require isolate realms: browserUse` |
| inside `isolate: { browserUse: true }` | preset loads, but the provider never receives `agent/created`, so Sessions get no `browser_*` tools |
| a second provider inside the preset | name clash with the profile one; calls fail with `playwright-mcp: browser tool belongs to another Session` |
section: Why the bundle mounts the provider

text: @local/dsh-browser-mode README · Why the bundle mounts the provider：The provider therefore has to live at the profile layer. This bundle mounts it from the `browser-source` row so the launch arguments belong to the plugin: switching the source disposes the old fiber and mounts a new one without restarting DSH. The cost is that the provider registers browser tools for **every** Session, which is what the gate is for.
section: Why the bundle mounts the provider
Why the gate refuses instead of hiding

text:
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Why the gate refuses instead of hiding：The only usable lever is `tools.guard()`: it runs synchronously in the call pipeline, a returned string refuses the call, and no listener can turn a refusal back into an allow.

Decision order:

```
browser tool call
  ├─ name does not start with mcp__playwright-mcp__ → pass
  ├─ it is browser_access                          → pass
  ├─ the Agent's preset is browser                  → pass
section: Why the gate refuses instead of hiding

text: @local/dsh-browser-mode README · How consent is recorded：`browser_access` calls `ctx.userQuestions.ask({ questions, agent, signal })`. When the user chooses Allow, the Agent id goes into an in-memory `Set`. Nothing is persisted; it does not survive a new Session or a restart.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Source (`browser-source`, inside the bundle)：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `edge` | `edge` / `builtin` / `endpoint` |
| `endpoint` | empty | CDP target when `source: endpoint` |
| `executablePath` | empty | custom browser path; empty means the default Edge install location |
| `headless` | `false` | `true` hides the window; keep it visible while debugging |

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Gate：Constants at the top of `browser-gate.js`:

```js
const TOOL_PREFIX = 'mcp__playwright-mcp__'  // the provider's tool prefix
const BROWSER_PRESET = 'browser'             // the preset id that may use the browser directly
const ACCESS_TOOL = 'browser_access'         // the consent tool name
const DENIED = '……'                          // the refusal text shown to the model
@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Gate：If you change the preset `id` in `preset-browser`, change `BROWSER_PRESET` too, otherwise the gate never recognises the mode.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Checks：1. In an ordinary Session ask it to open a URL: expect the refusal text and no browser window.
2. In the same Session say "I allow you to use the browser": the Allow / Do not allow prompt appears; after Allow the URL opens in a visible window.
3. Create a Browser mode Session: it opens URLs without asking.
4. Ask for one real interaction (click a button, read a title) and confirm the tool actually ran on the page.
5. Say "use the built-in browser" or call `browser_source({ source: "builtin" })`: the next page should open in Playwright's Chromium.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No "Browser mode" in the preset list | the bundle or its preset row is not active | check `include:preset-browser` in `list_plugins` |
| `Preset services require isolate realms: browserUse` | a provider row was put inside the preset | keep the provider at the profile layer; `browser-source` mounts it |
| No `browser_*` tools at all | `browser-source` is not active, or the old `browser-use-playwright-mcp` row still exists | check `include:browser-source`; delete the old provider row and reload |
| `browser tool belongs to another Session` | two Playwright providers in one process | keep only `browser-source` |
| The source switch does not show up | the Session still holds the previous MCP connection | call a browser tool again in that Session |
| An ordinary Session opens a browser | the gate is not active | check `include:browser-gate`; reload after code changes |
| The Allow button does nothing, or `human interaction is unavailable` | called from a child Agent | consent works only in the main Session |
| `content.some is not a function` | an old `browser_access` returned the wrong shap

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Compatibility：- Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, Windows 11, Edge.
- Depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, declared in `package.json`; adjust them together with DSH upgrades.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` must match the DSH runtime. The profile compatibility check disables any row whose peers do not match the running version; once that row is disabled nobody provides the `browserUse` service and `browser-source` stays `pending` forever.
- The gate uses public interfaces only: `tools.guard()`, `tools.register()`, `agentPresets.composedPreset()`, `sessionProjections.stateOf()`, `userQuestions.ask()`. If one is renamed, `browser-gate` drops out of `active` and the browser becomes available to every Session (the gate fails open but does not break Sessions); re-run the checks after upgrading.
- Source switching uses `settings.update()` on volatile fields plus the `loader/volatile-update` event. If DSH drops the volatile channel, switching degrades to an error that points at the YAML override; the browser itself keeps working.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Known limitations：- Ordinary Sessions still **see** the `mcp__playwright-mcp__*` names; only calling them is refused.
- Browser state (pages, login) lives inside one Session only.
- Consent is in memory and dies with a restart.
- A preset cannot be changed after the first turn, so ad-hoc browser use goes through `browser_access` rather than switching modes.
- Child Agents cannot show the consent prompt; approval happens in the main Session.
- Switching the source remounts the provider; open pages are not preserved.

@local/dsh-browser-mode README · Files：| File | Purpose |

| `browser-gate.js` | the gate: `tools.guard` refusal plus the `browser_access` consent tool |
| `browser-source.js` | the source plugin: mounts the Playwright MCP provider for Edge / bundled Chromium / CDP and registers `browser_source` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the `preset-browser` preset, the `browser-source` row, and the `browser-gate` row |
| `package.json` | bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`), exports, dependencies |
| `README.md`, `README.en.md` | Chinese and English docs |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | version history |
